name: PolicyCheck
description: Independent seller policy intelligence. Returns evidence-backed policy facts, source provenance, coverage, and an Ed25519-signed assessment. The calling agent decides whether to purchase.

skills.name: Seller Policy Facts
skills.description: Provide seller_url for policy discovery, url for one exact policy page, or policy_text for raw content. Embedded links in supplied text are not followed. Results include signed_assessment, signature, source excerpts, and analysis_status.
